The '''Great Assembly House''' was a building on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. In this bell-shaped hall, members of the [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses of Serenno]]&mdash;the six major [[Noble/Legends|noble]] families&mdash;met to discuss matters of planetary importance. Members of the [[lesser houses]] also took part to the parliament, although performing a purely advisory role.<ref name="AOTE2" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==History==
Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] drove the heirs of the Great Houses to mass parricide that came to be known as the [[Cleansing of Serenno]]. As a result, the Great Houses were brought in the bosom of the newly formed [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and [[Adan Dooku]] was appointed [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count of Serenno]], liege lord of all the other [[Noble/Legends|patricians]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Most of the [[galactic community]] never knew what really happened on Serenno that day, only that the event had seen the replacement of the old heads of houses by their sons.<ref name="AOTE2" />

Following the assassination of [[Adan Dooku]] in [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the Great Houses [[Dooku regency conclave|gathered]] to find a suitable [[Regent/Legends|regent]] for the new [[Count/Legends|Count]] of the [[House Dooku]], the ten-year-old [[Bron Dooku]].<ref name="AOTE2" /> Following the apparent death of Bron, Orom Malvern was then named the Count of Serenno with support of both the Great Houses, the new Count [[Pero Borgin]], and the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Imperial [[Serenno fleet|fleet]].<ref name="AOTE5">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 5|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 5]]</ref>
